groups.why: This trace row only checks that the layout control (usrLayoutControl2) in trace-table row D00-1-001 exists in the source, so no other row has the same target.
This trace row covers SetDivisionAuthCheck when the user has 0 authorized Divisions, a permission edge case that no other row matches.
This trace row checks 5 table rows for the cboDivision control, while V-92910544 also checks Year, so they are not the same check.
This trace row covers comma-separated multi-value key-in search (UC-06), which is not about an initial default value and matches no other row.
This trace row is for the cboOperationGroup control only, and no other row targets that control.
This trace row is for the txtUser control only, and no other row targets that control.
This trace row is for the txtItemId (Model/Nickname) control only, and no other row targets that control.
This trace row is for the cboValidYN control only, and no other row targets that control.
This trace row is for the clbFromSite control only, and no other row targets that control.
This trace row checks that the condition panel (usrConditionPanel1, HidePanel) in trace-table row D00-1-003 exists, so no other row has the same target.
This row expects only Year to default to the current year, while V-92910544 also checks Division, so the expected results differ and I kept them apart.
This row checks that the Reset Condition (F10) button restores the defaults after the conditions are changed, which is a different element and state from checking defaults on screen entry.
This row checks that, on a repeat search, only the changed condition changes and all other parameters stay the same, which is not an initial-value check.
This row checks Division and Year together right after the screen opens, and no other row covers both with the same expected result.
This row expects Version to be rebuilt and not empty after Division is changed, which is a different state and expectation from the defaults on screen entry.
This row expects the Ver. default to be empty for the Div 81/81_JV case, which is the opposite of V-9d9c2893 (not empty), so they cannot be merged.
This row counts how many times the checker auto-filled a required condition, which is a different kind of check from comparing a specific condition's default value.
